name: Three-Fiber Contraction Obstructions
definition: Put $Y=[d-2]$, $p=d-1$, and $q=d$. Define $\mathcal Z_d=2^Y\cup\{\{p\}\cup A:\varnothing\ne A\subseteq Y\}\cup\{\{q\}\cup A:A\subsetneq Y\}$.
parameters: $d\ge4$. It has $3\cdot2^{d-2}-2$ states and isometric dimension $d$.
canonical_form: It consists of a full base cube, a $p$-fiber missing its bottom endpoint, and a $q$-fiber missing its top endpoint.
recognition: The three-fiber representation certifies well-gradedness. Contracting $p$ or $q$ gives a one-vertex-deleted cube; contracting a coordinate in $Y$ gives $P_3\square Q_{d-3}$.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. The graph $\mathcal Z_4$ is one of the three dimension-four closed-orientable antipodal nonlearning graphs.
